name: @mournerliao/agent-skills
description: Personal capability library CLI for syncing curated agent skills (and later other capability kinds)

scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.validate:canonical: npm run build && node dist/cli.js validate skills/example && node dist/cli.js validate skills/summarize && node dist/cli.js validate skills/agent-skills && node dist/cli.js validate skills/commit
scripts.validate:provenance: npm run build && node dist/cli.js validate --catalog catalog/catalog.json
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run validate:provenance
